answer: Every new agent posts a 50-unit bond into escrow and names a sponsor; all sponsorships are drawn on an atlas of referrals. At a sponsor's summit, any peer may dispute its recruits within 10 epochs; if fake, bond and sponsor's stake are slashed and the challenger is paid. Star-shaped clusters get a saffron flag. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 50 = 5,000 units, lost on the first dispute, while an honest agent pays 50 once and keeps its reward.
